    # Cache: key -> (value, write_time)
    cache = {}
    # Track access order: key -> None (values unused, just for ordering)
    access_order = OrderedDict()
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        op_type = op[0]
        t = op[1]
        key = op[2]
        
        # Remove expired entries

                        if write_time + ttl <= t]

            del cache[k]
            if k in access_order:
                del access_order[k]
        
        if op_type == 'put':
            value = op[3]
            
            # If key exists, remove it from access order (will re-add it)
            if key in access_order:
                del access_order[key]

                lru_key = next(iter(access_order))
                del cache[lru_key]
                del access_order[lru_key]
            
            # Add/update entry
            cache[key] = (value, t)
            access_order[key] = None
            
        else:  # 'get'
            if key in cache:
                value, write_time = cache[key]

                if write_time + ttl > t:
                    # Move to end (most recently used)
                    del access_order[key]
                    access_order[key] = None
                    results.append(value)
                else:
                    # Entry expired
                    del cache[key]
                    del access_order[key]
                    results.append(-1)
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
